Name: Mesha, Son of Caleb
Summary: Firstborn son of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel, called the father of Ziph.
KeyStory: Named in 1 Chronicles at 1 Chronicles 2:42: Firstborn son of Caleb brother of Jerahmeel, called the father of Ziph.
LifeLesson: Named in the covenant line, Mesha stands among the individuals God placed within His people's story in 1 Chronicles.
